full_text:
ADDENDUM (Rules on Expenses for Taking Evidence before the Constitutional Court) <Constitutional Court Rule No. 256, July 6, 2010>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment to Other Rules)
(1) Omitted.

(2) The Rules on Payment of Expenses to Persons Providing Information before the Constitutional Court shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraph 1, "travel expenses" shall be replaced with "travel expenses (meaning transportation fares and daily travel allowances under the Regulations on Travel Expenses of Public Officials; hereinafter the same shall apply)".
